wilsonAmboseliWilson.yearOverYearNote: 2027 rack one-way ($224) is up from 2026's $204 - roughly a 10% increase, consistent across most routes in this document.

tsavoToWilson.confidenceNote: Minimum pax for the Tsavo->Wilson direction is stated as 6, vs 4 for Wilson->Tsavo - an asymmetric minimum, recorded as printed not corrected.

wilsonTsavo.airstrips: Finch Hattons, Mwatate, Taita Hills, Voi, Oldonyo Wuas, Kilaguni

amboseliTsavoMaraHighSeasonOnly.note: Identical rack/net/tax to 2026 - no increase on this specific route.

nanyukiToMasaiMara.note: May occasionally route via Wilson, connecting to Mara at 14:30 to arrive 15:15. Same fare as 2026, different scheduled departure time (2026: 11:00, 2027: 09:25).

loisabaToMara.confidenceNote: Source table shows '$415.00  $415.00' in the RACK O/W and RACK RTN columns for this specific row (duplicate figure across both columns) - recorded the RACK O/W value only ($415) and treated the duplicate as a likely table-formatting artifact in the source PDF itself, not corrected/guessed at what the RTN figure should be. Flag before quoting a Loisaba-Mara return on this specific leg.

wilsonNanyukiSamburuLewaLoisabaWilson.note: A separate route group from the -Mara one above: these are round-trip-style legs that return to Wilson rather than continuing to Mara. Same fares as the Wilson-X outbound legs already listed above; only new inbound times/labels captured here.

nanyukiKamokNamunyakMasaiMaraSetDepartur.confidenceNote: This section's own source table is internally confusing/inconsistent even in the paginated original (verified via direct page-image read, not a flattened-text artifact): it lists 'WILSON -> NAMUNYAK' THREE separate times with different departure times (08:30, 10:00) and a 'NANYUKI KAMOK -> NAMUNYAK' leg at 10:55, without a clear explanation of why Wilson would fly direct to Namunyak (skipping Nanyuki Kamok) on some rows but not others. Recording all rows exactly as printed rather than trying to resolve the apparent inconsistency - flag to ALS/Sunworld before using this section for an actual quote. Operates with a minimum of six (6) passengers overall (stated once, on the Namunyak->Mara row).

wilsonToNamunyakRow1.confidenceNote: Row shows a second net/tax/contract figure set (399.50/32/431.50) with no RACK RTN figure alongside it - likely a return-fare set misaligned under the one-way row. Recorded as printed.

wilsonMaraWilsonThreeXDaily.note: Expanded from 2X daily (2026) to 3X daily in 2027 - a genuine service increase.

morning.note: Morning service; drops/picks at multiple airstrips including Cottars & Siana; can connect to Ukunda/Amboseli/Tsavo same afternoon.

wilsonArushaZanzibarViaFlightlinkPartner.confidenceNote: IMPORTANT: these three rows appear in the ALS 2027 rate sheet's Wilson-Mara table block but are visually marked with a small 'FLIGHTLINK' logo in the source PDF (confirmed via page-image read) - meaning these routes are FlyALS-branded/sold but actually OPERATED by Flightlink (the Tanzania carrier separately extracted in flights-flightlink-2026.json), not by ALS's own fleet. Only RACK O/W is given, no return/net/tax/contract breakdown - likely a from-price teaser rather than a full contract fare. Treat as a partner/interline product, not a genuine ALS-operated route.

wilsonUkundaVipingoWilsonSeasonal.note: NET rate is inclusive of tax and applies equally to adult and child. Non-commissionable.
wilsonUkundaVipingoWilsonSeasonal.yearOverYearNote: Identical fares to 2026 - no increase on this route.

migoriToMara.note: Connects into Serengeti with Auric Air TZ.

maraSerengetiViaMigoriTarimeSeasonal.note: Nearly identical to 2026 rack figures, with small net-fare cent-level rounding differences (e.g. ChemChem net $599.25 in 2027 vs $599 in 2026). Reverse direction (Serengeti->Mara via Tarime/Migori) uses identical figures, schedule reversed.

maraKisumuDaily.note: NEW ROUTE for 2027, not present in the 2026 ALS contract at all.

kisumuToMara.note: Connects to Serengeti with Auric Air TZ.

maraSerengetiViaKisumuMusomaEffective1Ju.note: NEW ROUTE for 2027 (effective 1 Jun 2026 per source, i.e. already active before this contract's 2027 nominal start) - a SEPARATE and much more expensive circuit than the Migori/Tarime one above (flat $800 basic adult vs $590-755 rack via Migori/Tarime). Day-of-week dependent schedule (Mon/Wed/Fri vs Tue/Thu/Sat/Sun).
maraSerengetiViaKisumuMusomaEffective1Ju.reverseDirectionNote: Serengeti (via Musoma/Kisumu) to Mara uses the same $800 basic adult / $680 net figures with route-specific tax (127-162) and contract totals, schedule reversed (arrive Mara 14:00-15:30 depending on origin).

multiSectorDiscount2027.labelDiscrepancy: Section is literally titled 'Multi-Sector Discounts 2026' inside this 2027-dated contract document - a labeling error in the source, not corrected here. Figures themselves (20% for 3 sectors, 25% for 4+) match the 2026 file's multiSectorDiscount2026 structure exactly, so likely just a copy-paste heading that wasn't updated when the doc was rolled to 2027.
multiSectorDiscount2027.note: Applies only to Y-Class published RACK rates; taxes excluded from discount, applied per sector.

termsAndConditions.fareClass: Y-Class fares only; other classes have more restrictive conditions.
termsAndConditions.childFare: 75% of adult fare before tax, ages 2-11, bush flights only.

amendment.upTo24hrs: $30/person + fare difference if original class unavailable
amendment.within24to6hrs: 50% of ticket fare + fare difference if original class unavailable

cancellationPolicy.confidenceNote: MATERIALLY DIFFERENT structure from the 2026 contract (see flights-als-routes-2026.json main-2026-contract, which uses the same 24hr/6hr amendment tiers but doesn't spell out a distinct cancellation-specific policy at all - this 2027 doc adds one). Flag this as a genuine 2027 policy addition/change, not an inconsistency to resolve.
cancellationPolicy.within72to24hrs: 50% of ticket value, remaining balance held as credit (no refunds)
cancellationPolicy.within24hrs: Treated as No-Show - full ticket amount forfeited
cancellationPolicy.festiveSeason20DecTo10Jan: Cancellations allowed up to 7 days before travel; within 7 days incurs 100% charge
cancellationPolicy.groupTicketsNote: Group ticket cancellation policy differs from individual - not itemized in this document, flag as a gap if a group booking needs this.

baggage.firearms: Declared at check-in 4 hours before departure or to the pilot at bush airstrips.
